num_customers: <int> Number of customers to be served.
vehicle_capacity: <int> Maximum total quantity a single vehicle can carry across all its deliveries.
num_vehicles_upper_bound: <int> Maximum number of vehicles available in the fleet.
scheduling_horizon: <int> End of the planning period within which all vehicles must depart from and return to the depot.

depot.x: <int> Horizontal coordinate of the depot location.
depot.y: <int> Vertical coordinate of the depot location.
depot.time_window: <list[int], length 2> Earliest departure and latest return time for all vehicles at the depot.
depot.service_time: <int> Time spent at the depot before departing (always zero).

customers.id: <int> Unique identifier for the customer, numbered from 1 to num_customers.
customers.x: <int> Horizontal coordinate of the customer location.
customers.y: <int> Vertical coordinate of the customer location.
customers.demand: <int> Quantity of goods the customer requires to be delivered.
customers.time_window: <list[int], length 2> Earliest and latest time at which service may begin at this customer.
customers.service_time: <int> Time a vehicle spends at this customer regardless of the quantity delivered.

distance_matrix: <list[list[float]], shape [num_customers+1][num_customers+1]> Travel distance between each pair of locations, where row and column 0 is the depot and 1 through num_customers are customers.
travel_time_equals_distance: <bool> Whether the travel time between two locations equals the distance between them.
triangle_inequality: <bool> Whether distances and travel times satisfy the triangle inequality.
split_deliveries_allowed: <bool> Whether a customer's demand may be fulfilled by deliveries from multiple vehicles.
service_time_independent_of_quantity: <bool> Whether the service time at a customer is the same regardless of the quantity delivered.
